lead: Mani Ratnam is an Indian film producer, born on 2 June 1955 in Madurai.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has 41 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Padma Shri in arts.
This profile collects the Mani facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Mani Ratnam — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mani Ratnam was born on 2 June 1955 in Madurai, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Gopala Ratnam Subramaniam at birth and is publicly known as Mani Ratnam.
He received his education at University of Madras, Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies and Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College.
